notes.title: Final Content Update
notes.notes:
This is the last and final content update for RetroRange. Here going forward RetroRange will only receive updates for bugs or game-breaking issues.

Credits listing updated

788 Garage Studio will be moving on to a new project. Want to stay updated on developments join the Discord server https://discord.gg/STBxafC9jR
